fixture.baseCommitRule: copy the fixture, run docs sync and npm test, initialize Git, commit every resulting fixture file, and verify a clean tree before the first prompt

dimensions.criterion: Confirm project, caller and interface facts are read before one material API question, and synchronous batch, asynchronous job and client aggregation are all compared before recommending the ordered per-item synchronous contract.

Confirm that after the identity decision, one complete seven-core-section Spec with only material conditional sections is presented as a single review unit, and no project write occurs until its exact whole-document approval.

Confirm manage-specs classifies an independent identity and stops before writing, then only after identity approval prepares the complete draft and only after whole-document approval produces SPEC-014 with the reviewed 100-item API contract and CLI-generated current indexes.

Confirm the approved whole Spec is written exactly, checked and self-reviewed as draft, then the already stated continue intent routes to writing-plans by naming its inputs and owner while creating no Plan, Tasks or implementation.

hardRejects: writes code or a formal document before both the identity and whole-Spec approvals
skips the caller and interface evidence or fails to compare all three requested directions
creates a date-named memory document or writes a new Spec before its creation approval
asks for section-by-section approval or writes content that was not part of the reviewed complete Spec
creates Plan, Tasks, or implementation instead of stopping at the writing-plans transition
offers or starts the retired Visual Companion
changes source, clients, tests, package files, Architecture, or Runs
reads the hello-scholar Task Packet, production Skill, or other Eval evidence

scoreAnchors.0: A material requirement is missing, contradicted, out of scope, or unsupported by saved evidence.
scoreAnchors.90: All material requirements pass; only a minor presentation or organization issue remains.
scoreAnchors.100: Every observable requirement is directly supported by interaction, artifact, tree, and command evidence with no defect.

rounds.stopCondition: the initial design request is delivered
the Implementer has read project and caller facts and asked one material API question
rounds.message: 批量上限固定为 100。导出服务需要一次请求拿到逐项结果；单项缺失或失败不能丢掉成功项，并且调用方要能按项重试。本轮不需要异步进度查询。

rounds.stopCondition: all three approaches and one recommendation have been presented without writes
rounds.message: 选择同步批量入口。请保留异步作业和客户端聚合的取舍说明，但把同步逐项结果作为推荐目标。现在进入 manage-specs，只做 Spec 身份判断并停下来，不要写文件。

rounds.stopCondition: manage-specs has proposed an independent identity and stopped before project writes
rounds.message: 同意把它作为独立 Spec，使用全局下一个 ID SPEC-014 和 batch-retrieval Topic。请先一次给出包含七个核心章节和必要条件章节的完整 Spec 草稿让我整份审核；现在仍不要写文件。

rounds.stopCondition: one complete Spec has been presented as a whole review unit and no project writes exist
rounds.message: 完整 Spec 整份审核通过。按刚才审阅的精确内容写入 draft SPEC-014，运行 CLI 生成 Index 并自审；保持 draft，不冒充正式 acceptance。完成后按我已经说明的继续意图转交 writing-plans，只说明规划 owner 和输入，不创建 plan.md、tasks.md 或代码。

criticalPath: Read the API callers and current contracts, ask the first material question, and deliver the first evidence-backed design comparison before any document write.
